def control(obs):

    def rail_at(points, x):

    l=rail_at(m.get('left_rail',[]),2.0)
    r=rail_at(m.get('right_rail',[]),2.0)
    center=(l+r)/2 if l is not None and r is not None else 0.0

    hitch=obs.get('hitch_deg',0)
    steer=max(-40,min(40,2.4*(hitch-desired)))
